title: Unique Character
subtitle: 「獨特特色／鮮明身份／個別魅力」，究竟是哪一種 unique character？
description: 「獨特特色／鮮明身份／個別魅力」，究竟是哪一種 unique character？

words.note: 最直接、最自然的近義說法之一，表示一個人、地方、品牌或作品具有清楚可辨、與其他對象不同的身份特質。
words.example: The neighbourhood has a distinctive identity shaped by its history and architecture.
words.exampleZh: 這個社區因其歷史和建築而形成鮮明獨特的身份。

exercises.original: The neighbourhood has a unique character created by its old buildings and local traditions.
exercises.zh: 這個社區因老建築和本地傳統而形成獨特身份。
exercises.upgrade: distinctive identity · 獨特身份；鮮明個性

options.explanation: appearance = 只涵蓋外觀，未包含 local traditions。
style = 可描述建築風格，但未涵蓋整體社區身份。
distinctive identity = 歷史和文化共同形成一個可辨識的地方身份，distinctive identity 最精確。
fame = 知名度和身份特色不同。
personality only = 語意太窄，未涵蓋歷史文化。
ordinary identity = 與 unique character 相反。

exercises.original: The company wants to preserve the brand's unique character during expansion.
exercises.zh: 公司希望在擴張期間保留品牌的獨特身份。
exercises.upgrade: distinctive identity · 獨特身份；鮮明個性

options.explanation: popularity = 受歡迎度不是 identity。
style only = 設計風格只是品牌身份的一部分。
distinctive identity = 品牌擴張時要保持其可辨識身份，最自然是 distinctive identity。
ordinary image = 與獨特性相反。

exercises.original: The district's unique character makes it different from nearby areas.
exercises.zh: 這個地區的獨特身份令它有別於附近地區。
exercises.upgrade: distinctive identity · 獨特身份；鮮明個性

options.explanation: charm = 可以吸引人，但句子重點是 identity difference。
distinctive identity = makes it different from nearby areas 直接支持 distinctive identity。
reputation = 聲譽不等於身份特色。

words.note: 當 unique character 強調某人或某地帶有難以複製、令人喜愛的魅力時很自然；比 identity 更偏吸引力和氣質。
words.example: The old café has an individual charm that newer places cannot easily copy.
words.exampleZh: 這間老咖啡店有一種新店難以模仿的獨特魅力。

exercises.original: The small hotel has a unique character that large chains often lack.
exercises.zh: 這間小酒店有大型連鎖酒店往往缺乏的獨特魅力。
exercises.upgrade: individual charm · 個人魅力；獨特魅力

options.explanation: identity = 可以，但句子更強調令人喜愛的氣質。
individual charm = 和大型連鎖相比，小酒店的吸引力更適合描述為 individual charm。
standardization = 和 unique character 相反。

exercises.original: The old bookshop has a unique character that customers love.
exercises.zh: 這間老書店有顧客很喜愛的獨特魅力。
exercises.upgrade: individual charm · 個人魅力；獨特魅力

options.explanation: identity = 可用但 love 暗示魅力。
individual charm = customers love 強調吸引力，因此 individual charm 很自然。

exercises.original: Each café in the area has its own unique character.
exercises.zh: 這個地區每間咖啡店都有自己的獨特魅力。
exercises.upgrade: individual charm · 個人魅力；獨特魅力

options.explanation: standard look = 與 own unique character 相反。
appearance only = 未涵蓋氣氛和服務感覺。
individual charm = 每間店各有自己的吸引力和氣質，individual charm 最貼切。

words.note: 和 unique character 非常接近，表示某人、地方、建築或作品具有明顯可辨的風格和特徵。
words.example: The village has retained its distinctive character despite recent development.
words.exampleZh: 這條村莊雖然近年發展，仍保留其鮮明特色。

exercises.original: The town has kept its unique character despite rapid development.
exercises.zh: 這個小鎮儘管快速發展，仍保留其鮮明特色。
exercises.upgrade: distinctive character · 鮮明特色；獨特個性

options.explanation: appearance only = 小鎮特色不只外觀。
standard form = 和 distinctive 相反。
distinctive character = 地方整體可辨識的風貌最自然說 distinctive character。

exercises.original: The building's unique character comes from its unusual materials.
exercises.zh: 這座建築的鮮明特色來自其不尋常的材料。
exercises.upgrade: distinctive character · 鮮明特色；獨特個性

options.explanation: reputation = 材料不直接形成聲譽。
appearance only = 雖相關，但 distinctive character 更廣。
distinctive character = 建築因特殊材料形成明顯可辨特色，distinctive character 很精確。

exercises.original: The novel has a unique character that separates it from conventional thrillers.
exercises.zh: 這部小說有鮮明特色，使它有別於傳統驚悚小說。
exercises.upgrade: distinctive character · 鮮明特色；獨特個性

options.explanation: distinctive character = 作品整體風格與氣質有別於同類作品，distinctive character 最自然。
genre = 它仍可能屬同一 genre。
plot only = 特色不一定只來自情節。

words.note: 當重點是某人、地方或事物作為獨立個體所具有的身份和特徵時適用；比 charm 更中性、更偏身份認同。
words.example: Each district has its own individual identity.
words.exampleZh: 每個地區都有自己的獨特身份。

exercises.original: Each village has a unique character shaped by its history.
exercises.zh: 每條村莊都有由自身歷史塑造的獨特身份。
exercises.upgrade: individual identity · 個別身份；獨特身份

options.explanation: appearance = 歷史塑造的不只是外觀。
individual identity = 強調每個地方作為獨立個體的身份，individual identity 很自然。

exercises.original: The school encourages students to develop their own unique character.
exercises.zh: 學校鼓勵學生發展自己的獨特身份。
exercises.upgrade: individual identity · 個別身份；獨特身份

options.explanation: individual identity = 個人逐步形成自己的身份和特質，可用 individual identity。
appearance = 不合人格與身份發展。
style only = 只涵蓋一部分。
uniformity = 與 own identity 相反。

exercises.original: The redevelopment should not erase the area's unique character.
exercises.zh: 重建不應抹去該區的獨特身份。
exercises.upgrade: individual identity · 個別身份；獨特身份

options.explanation: appearance only = 重建影響的不只外觀。
individual identity = 地方因歷史、文化形成自己的 identity，individual identity 可自然表達。
standardization = 會是造成 identity loss 的過程，不是同義詞。

words.note: 較一般、易懂，表示某地、某物或某人具有與別不同的特色；語氣比 distinctive character 稍弱。
words.example: The market has a special character that attracts visitors.
words.exampleZh: 這個市場有一種獨特特色，吸引不少遊客。

exercises.original: The old market has a unique character that attracts tourists.
exercises.zh: 這個老市場有獨特特色，吸引遊客。
exercises.upgrade: special character · 獨特特色；特別個性

options.explanation: special character = 一般、自然地表達一個地方有特別特色，可用 special character。
standard look = 與 unique character 相反。
fame = 旅客被特色吸引，不是因知名度本身。
appearance only = 未涵蓋氣氛和文化。

exercises.original: The restaurant's unique character comes from its family history.
exercises.zh: 這間餐廳的獨特特色源自其家族歷史。
exercises.upgrade: special character · 獨特特色；特別個性

options.explanation: appearance = 家族歷史不只是外觀。
special character = 由歷史背景形成的整體特色可稱 special character。
menu only = 只是特色的一部分。

exercises.original: The building has a unique character despite its simple design.
exercises.zh: 這座建築雖設計簡單，仍有獨特特色。
exercises.upgrade: special character · 獨特特色；特別個性

options.explanation: special character = despite its simple design 表示整體仍有特別氣質，special character 很自然。
appearance only = character 可以包含空間感、材料和氛圍。
standard form = 與 special character 不符。

words.note: 非常接近 distinctive identity，強調身份在同類中具有明顯獨特性；常見於品牌、城市、社群和組織語境。
words.example: The brand has built a unique identity through its design and tone.
words.exampleZh: 這個品牌透過設計和語調建立了獨特身份。

exercises.original: The brand has developed a unique character through its visual design and voice.
exercises.zh: 品牌透過視覺設計和語調建立了獨特身份。
exercises.upgrade: unique identity · 獨特身份

options.explanation: appearance = 只有 visual design，不包含 voice。
unique identity = 品牌由視覺和語調共同塑造身份，unique identity 最精確。

exercises.original: The city wants to protect its unique character as tourism grows.
exercises.zh: 城市希望在旅遊業發展時保護其獨特身份。
exercises.upgrade: unique identity · 獨特身份

options.explanation: fame = 旅遊增長可能提升 fame，但原句是 identity preservation。
appearance only = 城市身份不只建築外觀。
unique identity = 城市在發展中保持自身身份，unique identity 很自然。

exercises.original: The company struggled to maintain its unique character after the merger.
exercises.zh: 公司合併後很難維持其獨特身份。
exercises.upgrade: unique identity · 獨特身份

options.explanation: appearance = 公司 identity 不只是視覺。
unique identity = 組織合併後保持自身 identity，是 unique identity 的典型語境。

words.note: 當 unique character 用來形容人、品牌、地方或作品像『有自己的個性』時適用；比 identity 更具人格化色彩。
words.example: The restaurant has a distinctive personality that sets it apart from its competitors.
words.exampleZh: 這間餐廳有鮮明個性，使它有別於競爭對手。

exercises.original: The café has a unique character that makes it feel unlike a chain store.
exercises.zh: 這間咖啡店有鮮明個性，令它感覺不像連鎖店。
exercises.upgrade: distinctive personality · 鮮明個性；獨特風格

options.explanation: appearance = 只說裝潢不足以涵蓋整體體驗。
distinctive personality = 把店舖人格化、強調整體氣質時，distinctive personality 很自然。

exercises.original: The magazine has a unique character created by its tone and design.
exercises.zh: 這本雜誌因語調和設計而有鮮明個性。
exercises.upgrade: distinctive personality · 鮮明個性；獨特風格

options.explanation: appearance only = tone 不是外觀。
distinctive personality = tone + design 形成像人格一樣的風格，distinctive personality 最貼切。

exercises.original: The neighbourhood's unique character comes from its mix of old and new.
exercises.zh: 這個社區因新舊融合而形成鮮明個性。
exercises.upgrade: distinctive personality · 鮮明個性；獨特風格

options.explanation: appearance only = mix of old and new 可涵蓋文化與生活。
distinctive personality = 地方若被人格化描述，可用 distinctive personality。

words.note: 當 unique character 的核心是視覺、設計、寫作、穿著或創作方式具有自身風格時最自然。
words.example: Her paintings have an individual style that is easy to recognise.
words.exampleZh: 她的畫作有一種很容易辨認的獨特風格。

exercises.original: Her work has a unique character that is easy to recognise.
exercises.zh: 她的作品有很容易辨認的獨特風格。
exercises.upgrade: individual style · 獨特風格；個人風格

options.explanation: fame = 辨識度不等於知名度。
identity = 可用，但藝術作品更自然說 style。
appearance only = style 包括更多創作方式。
individual style = 創作作品的可辨識方式最自然是 individual style。

exercises.original: The designer's unique character is visible in the use of colour and shape.
exercises.zh: 這位設計師的獨特風格可從色彩和形狀運用看出。
exercises.upgrade: individual style · 獨特風格；個人風格

options.explanation: personality = 這裡講的是設計作品，不是人的性格。
identity only = 可理解，但 visual design 更偏 style。
individual style = 色彩和形狀是設計 style 的直接線索。

exercises.original: Each architect was encouraged to preserve a unique character in the final design.
exercises.zh: 每位建築師都被鼓勵在最終設計中保留自己的獨特風格。
exercises.upgrade: individual style · 獨特風格；個人風格

options.explanation: uniform standard = 與 unique character 相反。
personality only = 設計風格不等於性格。
individual style = 設計作品呈現創作者自己的方式，individual style 最自然。

words.note: 當 unique character 指某一種讓人容易辨認、和其他對象區分開來的品質或特徵時可用。
words.example: The building's use of colour gives it a distinctive quality.
words.exampleZh: 這座建築的色彩運用令它具有鮮明特質。

exercises.original: The building has a unique character created by its curved roof.
exercises.zh: 這座建築因弧形屋頂而具有鮮明特質。
exercises.upgrade: distinctive quality · 獨特特質；鮮明特性

options.explanation: fame = 屋頂不直接產生 fame。
distinctive quality = 單一設計特徵令整體具有辨識度，distinctive quality 很精確。
standard feature = 與 distinctive 相反。

exercises.original: Her voice has a unique character that listeners recognise immediately.
exercises.zh: 她的聲音有一種聽眾立即能辨認的獨特特質。
exercises.upgrade: distinctive quality · 獨特特質；鮮明特性

options.explanation: identity = 可抽象理解，但聲音質感更自然說 quality。
style only = 不如 quality 表達聲音本身特質。
distinctive quality = recognise immediately 明確是可辨識的 distinctive quality。

exercises.original: The fabric has a unique character because of its uneven texture.
exercises.zh: 這種布料因不均勻質感而有獨特特質。
exercises.upgrade: distinctive quality · 獨特特質；鮮明特性

options.explanation: distinctive quality = 物料的觸感和視覺特徵很適合用 distinctive quality。
identity = 布料通常不談 identity。

words.note: 當 unique character 特別指地方、街區、城市或社區因歷史、文化和建築而形成的獨特風貌時很自然。
words.example: The redevelopment plan aims to preserve the area's local character.
words.exampleZh: 重建計劃旨在保留該區的地方特色。

exercises.original: The development should preserve the unique character of the old neighbourhood.
exercises.zh: 發展項目應保留舊社區的地方特色。
exercises.upgrade: local character · 地方特色；本地風貌

options.explanation: fame = 保育不是保留知名度。
appearance only = 地方特色也包括街道尺度、文化和用途。
standardization = 和 preserve character 相反。
local character = 規劃與保育語境中，local character 是非常自然的固定搭配。

exercises.original: New buildings should respect the area's unique character.
exercises.zh: 新建築應尊重該區的地方風貌。
exercises.upgrade: local character · 地方特色；本地風貌

options.explanation: local character = 城市規劃中，地方獨特風貌常直接稱 local character。
style only = 地方 character 比建築 style 更廣。

exercises.original: Tourism has changed some of the village's unique character.
exercises.zh: 旅遊業改變了村莊部分地方特色。
exercises.upgrade: local character · 地方特色；本地風貌

options.explanation: fame = 旅遊可能增加 fame，但句子是地方風貌改變。
local character = 村莊由文化、建築和生活方式形成的特色最自然是 local character。
appearance only = 文化和生活方式也可能改變。

words.note: 較書面、文學性，表示某人或某地有非常獨特、難以替代的魅力；比 individual charm 更具修辭色彩。
words.example: The small town has a singular charm that visitors remember for years.
words.exampleZh: 這個小鎮有一種獨特魅力，令遊客多年後仍記得。

exercises.original: The town has a unique character that visitors find unforgettable.
exercises.zh: 這個小鎮有一種令遊客難忘的獨特魅力。
exercises.upgrade: singular charm · 獨特魅力；非凡韻味

options.explanation: singular charm = unforgettable + place attraction 很適合文學化的 singular charm。
identity = 可以，但 unforgettable 更偏魅力。

exercises.original: The old theatre has a unique character despite its imperfections.
exercises.zh: 這間舊劇院雖有瑕疵，仍有獨特魅力。
exercises.upgrade: singular charm · 獨特魅力；非凡韻味

options.explanation: appearance only = 瑕疵與魅力可涉及整體氣氛。
singular charm = 即使不完美仍具吸引力，singular charm 很自然。
identity = 可用但不如 charm 帶吸引力。

exercises.original: The bookshop's unique character comes from its narrow rooms and handwritten signs.
exercises.zh: 這間書店的獨特魅力來自狹窄房間和手寫標誌。
exercises.upgrade: singular charm · 獨特魅力；非凡韻味

options.explanation: singular charm = 細節共同形成難以複製的吸引力，singular charm 很貼切。
size only = 狹窄只是其中一個特色。
standard appearance = 與 unique character 相反。

falseSynonyms.zh: 個性不一定等於 unique character personality 通常指人的性格，也可引申形容品牌或地方；unique character 更廣，可包括外觀、文化、歷史和氣氛。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Personality is one aspect of character, but unique character can include much more.

falseSynonyms.zh: 身份不一定表示獨特 identity 只表示某人或某物是誰／是甚麼；要表達『獨特』通常需要 distinctive / unique 等修飾。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An identity may be ordinary; a distinctive identity is clearly recognizable.

falseSynonyms.zh: 魅力不等於完整特色 charm 強調吸引力；unique character 還可以包括不一定討喜、但很可辨識的特徵。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Charm is attractive; character can be distinctive without being charming.

falseSynonyms.zh: 風格只是 unique character 的一部分 style 主要指外觀、表達或設計方式；unique character 可以同時包括歷史、文化、氣氛和功能。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Style contributes to character, but does not fully define it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 外表不等於整體特色 appearance 只描述外觀；unique character 可包括內在氣質、歷史和文化。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Appearance is visual; character is broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞不等於完整名詞概念 distinctive 表示有辨識度；要完整表達 unique character，通常需要搭配 identity / character / quality 等名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Distinctive is an adjective; distinctive character is a complete noun phrase.

falseSynonyms.zh: 單字本身與片語不同 unique 只表示獨一無二；character 只表示性格、特色或本質。兩者結合才形成『獨特特色』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Unique describes difference; character describes nature or personality.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有名特色／角色不等於獨特特色 famous 強調知名度；unique character 強調可辨識和與別不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Something can be famous without having a distinctive character.
